label: Check a PNR status on a real railway enquiry page
_status: STUB - NOT YET USABLE. The look_for values below are placeholders and have deliberately NOT been guessed. Capture the real page with the extension popup's 'Save page snapshot' button, read the actual accessible names out of the snapshot, and put them here. A recipe written from a guess resolves to nothing, Daari says 'I am not sure', and the generality claim fails live. enabled:false keeps it out of goal matching until it is real.
_scope: READ ONLY, and that is a hard boundary, not a preference. Enquiry and status only. Never a login, never a payment, never a booking. Daari points; the user acts; nothing here changes any record anywhere.
_captcha: If the page has a CAPTCHA, Daari must say only 'Type the letters in the picture yourself' and nothing else. It never reads the image, never guesses the letters, never solves it. Reading it would break rule 1 in spirit even though no click is involved, and solving it would make Daari a tool for defeating a protection the site chose to have. The step below uses done_when field_filled, so Daari simply waits for the user to do it.
